criteria.reason: src/index.js addVisibilityAttribute uses addFilter('blocks.registerBlockType', 'block-visibility-rules/add-attribute') and skips core/freeform and blocks failing hasBlockSupport(settings, 'customClassName', true), but the attribute is only `{ type: 'object' }` with no default.
withVisibilityControls is built with createHigherOrderComponent, renders <BlockEdit { ...props } /> and a VisibilityPanel wrapped in InspectorControls/PanelBody.
VisibilityPanel renders a RadioControl for the type, and its two DateTimePicker controls only appear inside `'date-range' === type && (...)`.
withVisibilityClassName (an editor.BlockListBlock HOC) passes className with 'has-visibility-rule' added to BlockListBlock.
src/editor.scss defines the dashed outline on .has-visibility-rule and is imported in index.js; build/index.css is registered and enqueued on enqueue_block_editor_assets and enqueue_block_assets.
updateRule calls doAction('blockVisibilityRules.ruleChanged', nextRule, previousRule, { clientId, name }) on every change.
ruleTypes = applyFilters('blockVisibilityRules.ruleTypes', getDefaultRuleTypes(), name) supplies the RadioControl options.
block_visibility_rules_register_attribute on register_block_type_args adds a visibilityRule object schema with type/start/end properties.
block_visibility_rules_render_block returns '' when $matches is false and $block_content otherwise.
block_visibility_rules_evaluate uses is_user_logged_in() and compares current_datetime() against DateTimeImmutable objects created with wp_timezone().
block_visibility_rules_register_assets includes build/index.asset.php and passes $asset['dependencies'] and $asset['version'] to wp_register_script.
Every API used (hasBlockSupport, getBlockType, getSettings from @wordpress/date, DateTimePicker, Notice, Button variant/size, wp_timezone, current_datetime, etc.) exists in WordPress or Gutenberg.
